newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe 1998 GDP growth forecast at 5.0 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe 1998 GDP growth forecast at 5.0 pct.

text.p: Zimbabwe's agriculture-powered economy is expected to grow by five percent in 1998 against an estimated 4.5 percent rise on gross domestic product (GDP) this year, Finance Minister Herbert Murerwa said on Thursday.
Murerwa also said in his budget speech that the country's current account deficit was expected to widen to 2.5 percent of gross domestic product in 1997 from 2.1 percent in 1996.
He said growth next year was likely to be spurred by a strong performance in agriculture, an expected resurgence in mineral prices and recovery of the southern African country's manufacturing sector.
"The prospects are bright," he said of 1998.

Zimbabwe has enjoyed two good rains seasons, but Murerwa said growth in 1997 had been severely affected by low mineral prices and excessive rains which cut agricultural output in many parts of the country.
